$comment: HZ-448. Plan drafts asserted by BOTH server/test/plan-draft-schema.test.mjs (domain/js/planDraft.js validatePlanDraft) and farm/tests/test_plan_draft.py (domain/py/plan_draft.py validate), so a draft the farm accepts is one the server's shape and dependency checks accept too. Each case edits `base`: `set` replaces the value at a dotted path (numeric parts are list indexes) and `drop` removes one. `expect` is the first error, or null for a valid draft. A `serverOnly` case breaks a rule only the server can check — whether a real key or repo exists — so the JS binding, given `context`, reports it, and the Python binding, which has no database, passes it.
